acceptance_criteria.criterion: A new standalone script (scripts/pds-charter-ledger-sweep.sh or .exs - it must NOT be bolted into pds-elixir-receipt-census.exs) DERIVES its disposition vocabulary from the charter text rather than transcribing a word list, and the PR quotes the derived vocabulary with per-word occurrence counts. The five-word list in circulation (CLOSED/paid/dissolved/MOOT/stale-open) is provably incomplete: `done` (86), `cancelled` (9) and `lifecycle_status:` (2) all assert disposition and none is in it.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: scripts/pds-charter-ledger-sweep.sh (standalone; shares no code with pds-elixir-receipt-census.exs). Section 2 prints 52 derived tokens = 6 CORE (the DISTINCT live lifecycle_status values over the 519-row pds- population: blocked/cancelled/considering/done/in_progress/open) + 47 charter idioms mined in-process as tokens the charter PREDICATES of a pds- slug minus the charter own 100 most frequent words, each with predicated_of_slugs and charter_lines counts (closed 4/108, refuted 3/107, deferred 2/41, paid 1/56, moot 1/8, re-scoped, mis-stated, close-eligible...). Section 2b measures the five-word list: it sees 13 of 105 candidate lines and is BLIND to 92; on THIS tree done=67 lines, cancelled=9, lifecycle_status=14 (the brief quoted 86/9/2 from the wave-39 charter in PR 9100 - derived, not transcribed).

acceptance_criteria.criterion: The extractor STRIPS THE SLUG FROM THE LINE before disposition matching, and EXCLUDES the `fails CLOSED` idiom explicitly WITH THE EXCLUSION COUNT PRINTED. Both are measured FP sources: the idiom accounts for 7 of 29 candidate lines in one pass, and pds-w29-s3-fake-fails-closed fires the lens four times on its own name alone.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: predications() calls SLUG.sub() on the copula window before any token match, and the TABLE shape skips any cell containing a slug - so no slug can fire the lens on its own name. IDIOM regex fail(s|ed|ing)?[ -]closed excludes the engineering idiom and section 3 of the run PRINTS the count AND the line numbers: '3. fails CLOSED IDIOM EXCLUSION - 7 slug-bearing lines excluded / lines: 3273, 3296, 3641, 7567, 7802, 7807, 8577'. Re-derived 7 on this tree, independently of the brief.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: EVERY candidate line is adjudicated - not sampled - into a COMMITTED table with one row per candidate: line number, slug, the charter's claim, the live lifecycle_status, and the verdict (AGREES / DISAGREES / NOT-A-DISPOSITION-ASSERTION / NOT-A-TASK). The PR states the candidate count it adjudicated and that it adjudicated all of them.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: CORRECTED STAMP (the first version of this evidence quoted a tally from memory instead of the run - exactly the sin this epic exists to catch; re-derived from the run output). scripts/pds-charter-ledger-adjudication.md carries 105 rows - ALL 105 candidate lines over 74 slugs, hand-adjudicated one by one, none sampled. Exhaustiveness is a MECHANISM, not a promise: a candidate whose (slug,line) fingerprint is absent from the table is an UNRESOLVED-CLAIM ARRIVAL and reds rc=1. Section 4 prints line / fingerprint / slug / asserted / live / verdict for every row; run of 2026-08-02 tally VERBATIM: {NOT-A-DISPOSITION-ASSERTION: 38, NOT-A-TASK: 14, AGREES: 44, DISAGREES: 9}. The stored column is the HAND reading (terminal / non-terminal / historical / non-disposition / non-task); the VERDICT is computed at run time from live lifecycle_status.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: THE THREE BLIND SHAPES ARE PRINTED WITH COUNTS, not omitted: (a) the multi-line RESIDUE count and how many slugs it exposes that the same-line lens never reaches, stated as a FLOOR; (b) the vocabulary-gap count (further same-line claims using idioms outside the derived core, with one worked example); (c) the non-task count. A run that prints only its findings and not its coverage is REFUSED by this criterion.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Section 6 of every run, unconditional. (a) RESIDUE, stated as a FLOOR: 381 charter lines carry a disposition token with a slug within +-2 lines but never on the same line, exposing 240 slugs the same-line lens never reaches, 67 of them LIVE NON-TERMINAL; same-line slug coverage 74 of 264 = 28 percent, and the run says floor because a claim more than 2 lines from its slug is in NEITHER number. (b) VOCABULARY GAP: 96 of 105 candidate lines rest on a charter idiom with no ledger status word on the line, over 69 distinct slugs; worked example printed: charter:5851 pds-bl-bp-search-false-negative tokens [refuted] live considering. (c) NON-TASK: 14 candidate lines, each NAMED (pds-scratch-target.sh, pds-pull-proof.sh x3, pds-idle-sampler.sh, pds-w15-fire-record.md, pds-crown-launch.sh, pds-ledger-census.sh, pds-receipt-census x2 CI-job name, and 3 planned slugs never filed - pds-w35-lens-stops-accusing, pds-w36-groupc-webhook-differentials, pds-w36-brief-help-seal-divergence, each CONFIRMED not_found by a second bp task get read).

acceptance_criteria.criterion: MUTATION-PROVEN THAT THE LENS CAN MISS: plant a synthetic CROSS-LINE disposition claim in a copy of the charter and prove the run NAMES it as residue rather than silently passing. This is the LENS-CAN-MISS discipline applied to a prose lens, and without it the coverage numbers are decoration.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: bash scripts/pds-charter-ledger-sweep.sh --selftest = 3 of 3, exit 0. (0) fail-closed oracle: the run REFUSES to start if the charter already contains the sentinel pds-selftest-cross-line-sentinel, so the corpus cannot contain its own oracle. (1) a COPY of the charter gets a planted CROSS-LINE claim (slug ends one line, 'is paid and CLOSED' begins the next); the same-line lens does NOT name it (rc=0, arrivals 0) - the blind shape is real, not asserted - and the residue lens PRINTS 'RESIDUE-SLUG pds-selftest-cross-line-sentinel lines=10481'. (2) the arm is proven able to FIRE: a second copy gets the SAME claim on ONE line and the run reds rc=1 naming 'charter:10480 pds-selftest-cross-line-sentinel [closed]'. Two in-corpus witnesses of the same shape are named in the table: charter:5854-5855 (the governing phrase 'NOT paid, checked and standing:' ends the previous line, so a same-line read INVERTS the claim) and charter:6293-6294 ('is lifecycle' ends the line, the value blocked is on the next).

acceptance_criteria.criterion: The instrument RESOLVES each surviving claim against LIVE lifecycle_status via bp, and reds on an UNRESOLVED-CLAIM ARRIVAL - never on a count. A count-shaped arm over this surface reds on unrelated ledger churn; arrival semantics does not.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: The ledger side is read live through bp doc query task --fields lifecycle_status, PAGED by explicit offsets with the ECHOED limit/offset asserted on every page (run of 2026-08-02: 5 pages, 1000/1000/1000/1000/446 = 4446 rows, pds- population 519) - a page whose echo does not match the ask exits 2 UNCHECKED rather than reporting a smaller board. A slug the paged corpus does not carry gets a SECOND read (bp task get) before the run may call it NOT-A-TASK, because the paged read is published-perspective. The red arm is ARRIVAL-shaped: rc=1 only on an UNRESOLVED-CLAIM ARRIVAL (a candidate fingerprint absent from the adjudication table) or a MISCLASSIFIED ARRIVAL (a row adjudicated non-task that now resolves in the ledger, or the reverse). No count is ever compared: 9 disagreements today exits 0, and a tenth would too - disagreements are FINDINGS for the lead, arrivals are the guard. Proven able to fire by selftest case 2 (planted same-line claim, rc=1, named).

acceptance_criteria.criterion: The four known disagreements are RE-DERIVED (pds-w29-pay-lb merged-but-open with PR #8644 MERGED, pds-bl-spill-dir-path-drift open 0/4, pds-w20-crown-fire considering 0/6, pds-w34-census-cas-shadow charter-self-contradiction) and each is DISPOSED: the ledger row corrected, or the charter claim recorded as needing correction in the epic's next charter PR. pds-w20-crown-fire is REOPENED AS A QUESTION rather than mass-cancelled - MOOT implying cancelled is an adjudication, not a rule.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: All four RE-DERIVED in-process from the live ledger, not transcribed - section 5 of the run prints them with charter line, live status and note: charter:3228 pds-w29-pay-lb terminal vs live open; charter:5849 pds-bl-spill-dir-path-drift terminal vs live open; charter:5850 pds-w20-crown-fire terminal(MOOT) vs live considering; charter:9820 pds-w34-census-cas-shadow quotes lifecycle_status open vs live done. The lens found FIVE MORE the brief did not name (charter:5851 bp-search-false-negative REFUTED vs considering, :6652 github-linkput fixed vs open, :6657 close-409-hint MIS-STATED vs open, :6921 w27-round-bare-30 shipped PR #8408 vs open, :8081 registry-postcondition c9-half-satisfied vs done) - nine total. DISPOSITION: filed and PUBLISHED as pds-w39-charter-ledger-corrections-owed (child of this task, 3 criteria), which names per row whether the LEDGER is stale, the CHARTER claim needs correcting in the epic charter PR, or the row needs re-cutting. NOT ONE ROW WAS FLIPPED BY THIS SLICE. pds-w20-crown-fire is left at considering - the question state - and the follow-up carries an explicit criterion that it be ruled on as a QUESTION and not mass-cancelled. Also re-derived and recorded: the charter contradicts ITSELF on pds-w29-pay-lb (charter:3228 says paid, charter:8075 says c13 is VIOLATED BY MERGED CODE).

acceptance_criteria.criterion: NO CHARTER FILE EDIT. `git diff --stat` shows no change to .claude/workflows/bp-pds-charter.md; charter corrections ride the epic's own charter PR. The slice's output is the script, its adjudication table, and bp ledger writes.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Commit a94eeced2 on loop-epic/the-charter-ledger-disagreement-sweep-wi-4 touches exactly two files, both NEW: scripts/pds-charter-ledger-adjudication.md (143 lines) and scripts/pds-charter-ledger-sweep.sh (584 lines), 727 insertions, 0 deletions. git diff --stat HEAD~1 -- .claude/workflows/bp-pds-charter.md prints NOTHING. The charter corrections are recorded instead as the published follow-up task pds-w39-charter-ledger-corrections-owed, to ride the epic charter PR. The script also shares no code with scripts/pds-elixir-receipt-census.exs - it reads the charter as prose and the ledger over bp.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: GATE: `bash -n scripts/pds-charter-ledger-sweep.sh` (or `elixir -c` equivalent) plus a run from the repo root that exits 0 on today's tree with its adjudication table and all three coverage counts printed, plus the planted-cross-line-claim run that names the residue. All three outputs pasted.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: THREE GATE OUTPUTS, all green on commit a94eeced2. (1) bash -n scripts/pds-charter-ledger-sweep.sh -> exit 0, silent. (2) bash scripts/pds-charter-ledger-sweep.sh -> EXIT=0. Header: 'charter .claude/workflows/bp-pds-charter.md (10479 lines) / table scripts/pds-charter-ledger-adjudication.md (105 adjudicated rows)'; ledger 5 echo-asserted pages 1000/1000/1000/1000/449 = 4449 rows, pds- population 522; section 4 prints all 105 rows, tally {NOT-A-DISPOSITION-ASSERTION 38, NOT-A-TASK 14, AGREES 44, DISAGREES 9}; section 6 prints all three coverage counts (residue 381 lines / 240 slugs / 67 live non-terminal, 28 percent same-line slug coverage stated as a FLOOR; vocabulary gap 96 of 105 over 69 slugs with the worked example charter:5851; non-task 14, each named); section 7 'unresolved-claim arrivals 0, misclassified arrivals 0'. (3) bash scripts/pds-charter-ledger-sweep.sh --selftest -> EXIT=0, '=== SELFTEST OK: 3 of 3 ===': same-line lens rc=0 sentinel NOT flagged, then 'RESIDUE-SLUG pds-selftest-cross-line-sentinel lines=10481 / PROVEN: the run NAMES the planted cross-line claim as residue', then the planted SAME-LINE claim 'unresolved-claim arrivals : 1 ... charter:10480 pds-selftest-cross-line-sentinel [closed]' with rc=1. Between the cached run and this live run the ledger grew 4446->4449 rows and both exited 0 - the arm is arrival-shaped, not count-shaped.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: MERGE-GATED (the LEAD closes this): the PR is merged and the lead has re-derived ONE of the four disagreements from the live ledger himself.
acceptance_criteria.evidence:
RE-DERIVED FROM THE LIVE LEDGER 2026-08-04 by pds-w47-n1-adjudication (worker pds-w47-adjudicator), not read from the builder's transcript; this stamp carries the CLI --merge-gated override, recorded rather than hidden.

MERGE HALF: charter table (origin/main .claude/workflows/bp-pds-charter.md:3961) resolves this task to PR #9116 "feat(pds): sweep the charter for closures the ledger does not carry, with the blind spot printed". gh pr view 9116 -> state=MERGED mergedAt=2026-08-02T07:59:11Z merge=aa81a9b6e410449b2b6c4cc526992d8ead907948 head=e20b5f229102871236e6b2a9e1e1cd7a703dc7a1; git merge-base --is-ancestor aa81a9b6e... origin/main -> ANCESTOR; check-runs on that head: Cloud gate=success Console gate=success Elixir gate=success PR references an active task=success (4/4).

THE DISAGREEMENT RE-DERIVED: `pds-w29-pay-lb`, merged-but-open.
(1) WHAT THE CHARTER ASSERTS. origin/main charter :4649 carries the task in the wave's shipped task-to-PR table: `| pds-w29-pay-lb | ...-print-what-th-0-r | #8644 | ... all 16 non-destroy lb-family sites paid; a 799-line stateful post-mutation-aware test file; 21 census keys flipped |`, i.e. the row reads as delivered.
(2) WHAT THE PR SAYS. gh pr view 8644 -> state=MERGED, mergedAt=2026-07-31T20:49:30Z, mergeCommit 9a1811da47402ef5e3fcdec633592289236dc88c, title "feat(hetzner): lb-family receipts print what the server now reports"; `git merge-base --is-ancestor 9a1811da4 origin/main` -> rc=0 ANCESTOR. The code IS on main.
(3) WHAT THE LIVE LEDGER SAYS TODAY. `bp task get pds-w29-pay-lb -o json` -> lifecycle_status = **open**, acceptance criteria **12/14** met, updated_at 2026-07-31T21:09:40Z. Merged, and still open - the disagreement is REAL and STILL LIVE on 2026-08-04.
(4) AND IT IS CORRECTLY OPEN, which is the point: PDS-D433 rules that c13 must NOT be stamped because it is VIOLATED BY MERGED CODE - its text forbids editing internal/cli/hetzner_net_cmd_test.go, and I re-ran the check: `git show --stat 9a1811da4 | grep hetzner_net_cmd_test.go` -> `internal/cli/hetzner_net_cmd_test.go     |  13 +`. The file WAS edited. So the charter's shipped-row framing and the ledger's open row do not disagree about the FACTS, they disagree about the DISPOSITION - and the ledger is the one that is right.

VERDICT: one of the four disagreements re-derived from the live ledger, by run, on 2026-08-04. NOT CLOSED - the close seal is the lead's. Ledger: tooling/grip/ledger/pds-w47-n1-adjudication-2026-08-04.md

documents.description:
WAVE 39. THE SWEEP IS DECIDABLE - and the answer is neither "swept" nor "proven undecidable" (PDS-D565).

A same-line lens (a pds-* slug co-occurring with a disposition token on one line) over the charter's 10,478 lines yields 46 CANDIDATE LINES / 41 SLUGS. That population is small enough to hand-adjudicate EXHAUSTIVELY inside this slice, which is why criterion 3 of the wave-38 wording ("if undecidable, prove it") is not the outcome here. But same-line coverage is 43%, and a builder who claims a completeness sweep over 43% commits this epic's own disease one lens down.

FOUR DISAGREEMENTS ALREADY IN HAND (re-derive all four; do not trust this list):
1. charter:3228 `pds-w29-pay-lb` - "all 16 non-destroy lb-family sites paid", PR #8644 MERGED 2026-07-31T20:49:30Z; live lifecycle OPEN at 12/14, claim expired, c9 noted "merge-gated for the LEAD". Merged-but-open: the charter is right about the WORK, the ledger is stale.
2. charter:5849 `pds-bl-spill-dir-path-drift` - "is paid"; live OPEN 0/4.
3. charter:5850 `pds-w20-crown-fire` - "is MOOT (it arms a crown sealed 12/12)"; live CONSIDERING 0/6. NOTE: calling this a disagreement assumes MOOT implies cancelled - that is an adjudication, not a charter rule. Reopen the question rather than mass-cancelling.
4. charter:9820 `pds-w34-census-cas-shadow` - the charter QUOTES "lifecycle_status":"open" while charter:2628/:2681 say done and live is done. The charter disagrees with ITSELF; already adjudicated by ledger-hygiene-w37, so this is a stale QUOTE, not a new disagreement.

THREE MEASURED BLIND SHAPES THE INSTRUMENT MUST PRINT WITH COUNTS:
(a) RESIDUE: 59 lines carry a disposition word within +-2 lines of a slug but never on the same line, exposing 54 slugs the same-line lens never reaches - 23 of them live NON-TERMINAL (pds-bl-close-audit-gaps, pds-w25-round-parked, pds-w26-stamp-readback ...). The charter is hard-wrapped prose; slug and verb routinely land on different lines. This is a FLOOR, not a total.
(b) VOCABULARY GAP: beyond the derived core words, 21 further same-line claims over 17 slugs assert disposition with REFUTED / parked / RE-SCOPED / superseded / deferred / retired / absorbed. Worked example: charter:5851 calls pds-bl-bp-search-false-negative's premise REFUTED while live lifecycle is `considering`. The vocabulary must be DERIVED FROM THE CHARTER, never transcribed from a brief - the five-word list in circulation cannot see `done`, `cancelled` or `lifecycle_status:`, which is how the charter asserts most often.
(c) NON-TASK FALSE POSITIVES: 7 of the 41 extracted "slugs" are not tasks at all - pds-ledger-census, pds-live-hetzner-placement-group, pds-scratch-target, pds-w14-fire-record, pds-w15-fire-record (script filenames), pds-tasks-stop-under-repor-3 (a branch fragment), pds-wave-27-2026-07-31 (a Paper slug).

TWO MECHANICAL TRAPS, BOTH MEASURED: the `fails CLOSED` engineering idiom is the largest FP source (7 of 29 candidate lines in one pass - charter:3273, :3641, :7807 and the fail-closed table rows), and one slug (pds-w29-s3-fake-fails-closed) fires the lens FOUR TIMES purely on its own name. STRIP THE SLUG FROM THE LINE BEFORE MATCHING, and exclude the idiom EXPLICITLY WITH ITS COUNT PRINTED.

SCOPE: this arm reads the charter as PROSE. It shares no code with scripts/pds-elixir-receipt-census.exs and must not be bolted into it. It does NOT edit .claude/workflows/bp-pds-charter.md - the charter corrections ride the wave's own charter PR. It writes bp ledger rows and its own committed adjudication table.
